notes.title: Urgent) Timer bug has been fixed
notes.notes: "I have fixed the bug that occurred during timer pause. If the previous bug made the game difficult, I apologize. Now, if you reinstall, you should be able to enjoy the game without any issues. I apologize once again for the inconvenience."

notes.title: Notice of Dialogue Typo Corrections
notes.notes:
Hello,

I recently discovered some typos in the dialogues of our game and have promptly carried out correction work.

notes.title: Save Slot Added
notes.notes: "Now you can use up to 20 save slots! Previously, there was only one, but now you can save your progress multiple times."
